READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", 1) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(a) from values 1, 2, 3 as data(a)
READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", 1), ("two", 2), ("three", null) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", null), ("two", null) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", 1), ("two", 2L) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(udf(a)), udf(b) from values ("one", 1 + 0), ("two", 1 + 3L) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", array(0, 1)), ("two", array(2, 3)) as data(a, b)
READ	select udf(a), b from values ("one", 2.0), ("two", 3.0D) as data(a, b)
